name: Independent reviewed-negative supplement for the failed MARS-Hyperspectral Stage B gate
research_question: Can a separately curated, exhaustively labeled AVIRIS-NG training archive contribute at least 28 non-duplicate near-simultaneous Sentinel-2 or Landsat 8/9 reviewed negatives without changing the original 300-negative gate?

prior_result_disclosed_before_freeze.unchanged_policy: The original threshold remains 300. This protocol may only add independently sourced pairs; it may not relabel, widen time windows, admit Landsat 7, or count duplicate target acquisitions.

candidate_source.name: Dataset for Towards Operational Automated Greenhouse Gas Plume Detection and Delineation
candidate_source.dataset_license_status: No explicit reusable data license was visible on the Zenodo record at freeze time; this is a mandatory gate, not an assumed permission.

metadata_archive.name: multicampaign.tar
metadata_archive.contents_claim: Combined AVIRIS-NG train/test dataset definitions only; no retrieval rasters.

source_evidence_known_before_freeze: The paper states that training and validation use quality-controlled scenes whose plume candidates are exhaustively identifiable by domain experts.
Background tiles are sampled only after excluding plume tiles and every pixelwise plume label; same-class overlap is bounded.
Airborne campaign partitions are spatially stratified by connected components of overlapping flightline footprints.
The public multicampaign archive is small enough for a metadata-first audit, whereas the raster archives total roughly 25 GB for the three AVIRIS campaigns.
The source is primarily United States airborne campaign data and may overlap MARS-S2L Permian or California geography.
Whether the compact CSV definitions expose exact crop georeferencing and UTC is unknown and must be tested before any raster acquisition.

downloads_forbidden: any retrieval GeoTIFF or label raster
any target Sentinel-2 or Landsat asset
eligibility: exact finite WGS84 crop center and UTC must be recoverable without bulk raster transfer
exclude every location within 25 km of an official MARS-S2L test location
exclude exact or 25 km duplicates of an already counted MARS-Hyperspectral negative pair
exclude ambiguous, low-quality, or non-exhaustively labeled scenes
metadata_stage.failure_action: Stop before target catalog query or bulk source acquisition; retain compact receipts and seek another negative source.

target_catalog_stage.same_acquisition_deduplication: For each source crop and target sensor, count at most one product per target acquisition UTC; tile-edge duplicates choose the lower tile cloud fraction then lexical product ID.
target_catalog_stage.pass_action: Only then may a separate target-band acquisition and cross-modal modeling protocol be preregistered.
target_catalog_stage.failure_action: Retire this supplement without changing any threshold or opening target assets.

protected_boundaries.jpl_test_split: Never used for acquisition selection, fitting, calibration, or architecture choice.
protected_boundaries.mars_s2l_official: No label, mask, score, threshold outcome, or prediction may be opened.
protected_boundaries.bulk_policy: All third-party archives, metadata extracts, and detailed catalogs remain beneath ignored .research roots.

claim_boundary: A pass establishes acquisition feasibility only. It does not establish cross-sensor label validity after local observability checks, model complementarity, calibration, or superiority over MARS-S2L.
